prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production opaque depth plate for an original Yautja side-view 2D fighting stage 'Salle du Porte-Cendres', a clan command room built beside controlled geothermal machinery. This is an ORIGINAL project environment, not a named canonical film location. Reference1 informs low broad layered basalt roofs and ribbed dark alien alloy only; no copied text. Landscape1536x1024 or wider, level frontal stage camera, no tilt. Background contains only middle/far architecture and deep space. No nearby floor, platform, foot-contact line or foreground props. The bottom quarter descends into distant rock/machine depth, not black blank space.
Scene: a broad enclosed cavern chamber inside an ash-black escarpment. Thick layered stone ceiling and solid curved bronze ribs support the roof. The rear wall contains a long horizontal geothermal heat-exchanger bank protected behind dark segmented translucent ceramic shields, glowing a muted deep amber from INSIDE contained machinery. Large ribbed conduits and physically anchored metallic braces connect the exchanger to a recessed low command alcove far to the right. A narrow horizontal opening at upper left reveals a distant copper volcanic ridge under grey ash haze. Rugged geological mass with sophisticated utilitarian hunter-clan equipment. No loose fire, no exposed lava flowing into the arena. The central background stays spacious, with machinery evenly distributed and all heavy parts clearly supported. Subtle warm reflections on rough basalt, very dim crimson indicators, calm lower middle for later combatants.
Distinctive visual logic: replace mystical floating brazier/altar imagery with a physically constructed clan geothermal command chamber. No floating bowl, floating rock, magic, gods, statues, huge mask faces, throne, human ceremonial altar, Gothic arches, cathedral spires, torches, flames, flags, text, labels or UI. No characters, animals or silhouettes. Detailed hand-painted realistic videogame backdrop, controlled contrast, neutral technical materials shaped in alien curved/ribbed forms. No playable floor painted.
